rubric: The same payments move as three small steps with a flag and an ordered migration.

criteria.risk_appropriate: Is the plan appropriate to its risk level (given with the plan)? A high-risk plan names a migration or a flag strategy and keeps its steps small enough to review; a low-risk plan does not need either.

reading.why: A high-risk plan names a flag and a migration order and keeps steps small; this one writes to both stores behind a flag, backfills in batches and drops the column last, in steps of 30 to 140 lines.
